notes: «وبهذا الاسناد» takes over محمد بن الحسن and الحسين بن الحسن بن أبان from prev2 (the walk passes prev1, which opens with the same phrase); the text repeats الحسين بن سعيد, so the inherited names stop before it.
«أحدهما» (one of the two Imams) is not named, so it is unnamed; the saying is the Imam's, as the text relays it.
